**Swiss 300B Foundation Model — Investor One-Pager**

**Decision**  
We will train and own a 300B-parameter language model from scratch. This creates a proprietary, Switzerland-based model asset that can be monetized directly through API usage, enterprise subscriptions, fine-tuning, and licensing.

---

### **Cost Plan — 18-Month Build**

| Cost Block | Estimate |
|---|---:|
| GPU pretraining + post-training | $45M – $65M |
| Engineering, ML, data, infrastructure | $15M – $25M |
| Data, evaluation, compliance, security | $8M – $15M |
| Cloud, storage, networking, MLOps | $8M – $12M |
| Legal, PMO, contingency | $10M – $15M |
| **Total** | **$86M – $132M** |
| **Base case** | **$105M** |

---

### **Revenue Plan — Post-Launch**

Assumptions: API pricing of **$0.50–$1.20 per 1M tokens**, 20–60 enterprise customers, 20–80 fine-tuning customers, and 3–10 licensing/white-label deals.

| Revenue Stream | Year 1 | Year 2 | Year 3 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| API usage | $15M – $35M | $70M – $160M | $200M – $450M |
| Enterprise subscriptions | $5M – $12M | $25M – $60M | $70M – $160M |
| Fine-tuning / managed models | $3M – $8M | $15M – $40M | $45M – $100M |
| Licensing / on-prem / white-label | $7M – $18M | $35M – $100M | $110M – $280M |
| **Total** | **$30M – $73M** | **$145M – $360M** | **$425M – $990M** |

**Base case:** **$45M** in Year 1, **$200M** in Year 2, **$575M** in Year 3, at **60–75% gross margin**.

---

### **Bottom Line**  
A **$105M investment** creates a Swiss-owned foundation model that becomes the company’s main revenue engine. At base case, Year-2 revenue is roughly **2x the total build cost**, and the model can be reused across every product line without rebuilding the core asset.
